source_row.stem: A client reports their hearing aid is not working. Basic nursing troubleshooting includes checking:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"The battery, ensuring it is properly inserted and not depleted, and checking for earwax blockage","B":"Only whether the device is the correct color","C":"Only the volume setting with no other assessment","D":"Nothing, since hearing aids require professional repair for any issue"}}
source_row.rationale: Basic hearing aid troubleshooting includes checking the battery (proper insertion, charge level) and checking for earwax blockage in the device or ear canal, common simple causes of malfunction.
source_row.source_name: Standard Nursing Fundamentals — Assistive Device Troubleshooting
